versions.changelog: Restore readable Chinese Demo text and keep the ClawHub file-preview link without inline images, so the public page has no broken image elements.
Remove inline demo images that ClawHub strips or optimizes incorrectly; keep a direct ClawHub file-preview link plus Markdown preview so the public page has no broken images.
Inline the demo screenshot as a data image in the Demo section, with a direct file-link fallback.
Bypass ClawHub Markdown image optimization for the demo screenshot by using a raw HTML image with a direct file link fallback.
Render the real demo screenshot on ClawHub by publishing it as a text SVG asset with an embedded compressed screenshot.
Show the real demo screenshot on the ClawHub page using the published PNG asset endpoint.
Make Demo preview render reliably on ClawHub by replacing filtered inline SVG with Markdown-native visual tables.
Fix Demo preview by replacing the relative image asset with an inline visual mockup.
Fix Demo image rendering by replacing the embedded bitmap SVG with a lightweight pure SVG effect mockup.
Replace plain Demo text with an embedded visual effect image for the route planner demo section.
Initial release: generates child-friendly half-day route stories using Amap geocoding, nearby POI search, walking route estimation, and static map preview.
